title: Turn off Apple Intelligence on macOS 27 and get its disk space back
summary: A macOS utility that allows users to disable Apple Intelligence features and reclaim the disk space consumed by these AI features on macOS. The tool provides a simple way to remove unwanted AI functionality from the system.
problem_solved: Apple Intelligence consumes significant disk space on macOS, and users need a way to disable and remove these AI features.
why_valuable: Gives users control over their system by freeing up disk space and allowing them to opt out of AI features they don't need or want.
